map.电动车充电费用计算器 使用指南: EV Charging Cost Calculator - User Guide
map.按电池容量、SOC 区间、充电效率、电价、充电功率与百公里电耗，计算本次充电电量: Calculate battery-side energy, grid draw, charging cost and time, added range and cost per kilometer from battery capacity, SOC window, efficiency, tariff, charger power and consumption; compare petrol cost and estimate annual savings. Suitable for home and public fast charging.
map.电池侧电量 = 电池容量 ×（目标 SOC − 起始 SOC）÷ 100；电网取: Battery-side energy = battery capacity × (target SOC − start SOC) ÷ 100; grid energy = battery-side energy ÷ efficiency; cost = grid energy × tariff; charging time ≈ grid energy ÷ charger power; added range = battery-side energy ÷ consumption per 100 km × 100; cost per km = cost ÷ added range; saving per 100 km = petrol cost per 100 km − EV cost per 100 km.
map.填写电池容量（kWh），可在车辆铭牌、说明书或车机里查到。: Enter battery capacity (kWh) from the nameplate, manual or vehicle display.
map.填写起始 SOC 与目标 SOC；日常通勤常用 20%–80%，长途前再临时提高: Enter start and target SOC; 20%–80% is common for daily commuting, with a higher target before a long trip.
map.填写充电效率；交流慢充常见 85%–92%，直流快充约 90%–95%。: Enter charging efficiency; AC charging is commonly 85%–92%, DC fast charging about 90%–95%.
map.填写电价与充电功率；家充常见 7 kW，公共快充 60–180 kW。: Enter tariff and charger power; home charging is often 7 kW, public fast charging 60–180 kW.
map.填写百公里电耗、油价与燃油车百公里油耗，用于每公里与油费对比。: Enter consumption, petrol price and petrol-car consumption for the per-kilometer and fuel-cost comparison.
map.需要年度估算时填写年行驶里程；填 0 或留空则只算单次。: For annual estimates, enter yearly distance; 0 or blank calculates a single charge only.
map.家充核算：60 kWh 电池、20%→80%、7 kW 家充、电价 0.6 元/: Home charging: 60 kWh battery, 20%→80%, 7 kW charger, 0.6 CNY/kWh.
map.公共快充比价：同一 SOC 区间，比较 1.2 元/kWh 与 1.8 元/kW: Public fast charging: compare the same SOC window at 1.2 and 1.8 CNY/kWh.
map.油电对比：按自己的百公里电耗、油价与油耗，算每百公里节省和年度节省。: Petrol vs EV: use your own consumption, petrol price and fuel economy to estimate per-100-km and annual savings.
map.60 kWh 电池、20%→80%、效率 90%、电价 0.6 元/kWh、7: 60 kWh battery, 20%→80%, 90% efficiency, 0.6 CNY/kWh, 7 kW charger, 15 kWh/100km, petrol 8 CNY/L, petrol car 8 L/100km, 15,000 km/year: battery-side 36 kWh, grid 40 kWh, cost 24 CNY, charging about 5.71 h, added range 240 km, about 0.10 CNY/km and 10 CNY/100 km; the petrol car costs about 64 CNY/100 km, saving about 54 CNY/100 km and 8,100 CNY/year.
map.本工具纯前端运行，输入不上传服务器。充电时间按恒定功率估算，实际受充电曲线、电池: This tool runs entirely in the browser and does not upload inputs. Charging time assumes constant power; the real curve, battery temperature, BMS current limit and charger output all matter. Efficiency covers charger, onboard charger and battery losses. The petrol comparison excludes maintenance, insurance, depreciation, plates and access rules. Refer to the vehicle nameplate, charger manual and local tariff rules.
map.60 kWh 电池从 20% 充到 80% 要多少电？: How much energy does a 60 kWh battery need from 20% to 80%?
map.电池侧约 36 kWh；按 90% 充电效率，电网取电约 40 kWh。: About 36 kWh enters the battery; at 90% efficiency the grid supplies about 40 kWh.
map.7 kW 家充要充多久？: How long does a 7 kW home charger take?
map.以上例 40 kWh 电网取电计算，理论约 5.7 小时；实际会受车载充电机与电: For the 40 kWh grid-energy example, about 5.7 hours in theory; onboard charger and battery temperature can extend it.
map.每公里电费怎么算？: How is cost per kilometer calculated?
map.本次电费 ÷ 本次增加续航。增加续航 = 电池侧电量 ÷ 百公里电耗 × 100: Charging cost ÷ added range; added range = battery-side energy ÷ consumption per 100 km × 100.
map.和油车比能省多少？: How much does it save versus a petrol car?
map.示例中电动车百公里约 10 元，燃油车约 64 元，每百公里省约 54 元；年行: In the example, the EV costs about 10 CNY per 100 km and the petrol car about 64 CNY, saving about 54 CNY per 100 km, or about 8,100 CNY a year at 15,000 km.
